transcript: Regret may be a capacity that may be uniquely human Looking back on past choices and imagining If only I had done that is a notion That requires complex thinking In high school, I damaged a relationship With a girlfriend in my class In a trivial quarrel, I hurt her pride If only I had been more polite back then If only I had been able to perceive her feelings Unfortunately, the young me did not have that capacity On graduation day, she came up to me nervously Gave a short wave and left after that We lost touch It was mostly my responsibility Even after decades I sometimes think of her Through news from a mutual friend I learned that she had built a happy family Along with relief I also felt a faint sadness Regret is at times an unpleasant feeling But to confront regret is also part of growth We cannot change the past, but we can learn from it If I could go back, I would confidently tell her a simple thank you I am slowly forgiving my past self For not having said it
